field.name: id_visita
field.label: COM_ERESERVAS_FORM_LBL_RESERVA_ID_VISITA
field.query: SELECT '' AS `id`, 'COM_ERESERVAS_RESERVAS_ID_VISITA_FILTER' AS `val` UNION SELECT `a`.`id` AS `id`, CONCAT(`b`.`nombre`, ' - ', SUBSTRING(`a`.`fecha`,1,10), ' - ', SUBSTRING(`a`.`hora_inicio`,1,5)) AS val FROM `#__ereservas_visita` as `a` LEFT JOIN `#__ereservas_tipo_visita` as `b` ON (a.id_tipo_visita = b.id)

field.name: id_idioma
field.label: COM_ERESERVAS_FORM_LBL_RESERVA_ID_IDIOMA
field.query: SELECT '' AS `id`, 'COM_ERESERVAS_RESERVAS_ID_IDIOMA_FILTER' AS `val` UNION SELECT `id` AS `id`, `nombre` AS val FROM `#__ereservas_idioma`

field.name: id_usuario
field.label: COM_ERESERVAS_FORM_LBL_RESERVA_ID_USUARIO
field.query: SELECT '' AS `id`, 'COM_ERESERVAS_RESERVAS_ID_USUARIO_FILTER' AS `val` UNION SELECT `id` AS `id`, `name` AS val FROM `#__users`

field.name: id_pais
field.label: COM_ERESERVAS_FORM_LBL_RESERVA_ID_PAIS
field.query: SELECT '' AS `id`, 'COM_ERESERVAS_RESERVAS_ID_PAIS_FILTER' AS `val` UNION SELECT `id` AS `id`, `nombre` AS val FROM `#__ereservas_pais`

field.name: id_tipo_cliente
field.label: COM_ERESERVAS_FORM_LBL_RESERVA_ID_TIPO_CLIENTE
field.query: SELECT '' AS `id`, 'COM_ERESERVAS_RESERVAS_ID_TIPO_CLIENTE_FILTER' AS `val` UNION SELECT `id` AS `id`, `nombre` AS val FROM `#__ereservas_tipo_cliente`
